predictions.criterion: DH native-complement form first indefinite m in [50,56]; distinguish from full-carrier onset and scalar K signs
zeta prime-power jump signs homogeneous; distinguish finite discrete increments from fixed-N one-sided atom-derivative jumps

source_gate: Read Suzuki primary papers and verify actual source/kernel map and Weyl normalization before labeling 1/(Imz*K) an actual Weyl radius. Undefined/indefinite forms reported rather than treated as Hilbert RKHS.
point_evaluation_gate: Resolve whether e(z) is physical cosine evaluation or Fourier evaluation; both can be shown as labeled formal alternatives if source does not identify one.
monotonicity_gate: Do not conflate nonnested m-dependent finite carriers/moving complements with nested restrictions of one fixed positive kernel. No posthoc fitted or absolute-value radius.
